question: At which of the following places was the ‘Street Theatre and Performing Arts Fellowship’ scheme launched in January 2021 to give artists an opportunity to showcase their craft?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Delhi Deputy CM Manish Sisodia, on 15th January 2021, launched the "Street Theatre and Performing Arts Fellowship" scheme.
 
• It will give artists an opportunity to showcase their craft.
 
• The flagship scheme has been started by the Sahitya Kala Parishad under the Department of Arts, Culture and Languages.
 
• Nearly **500 artists** have been selected for this scheme.
 
• It offers a monthly stipend of Rs 5,000 to those who are selected for it.
 
• The selected artists had performed in a team of 10 every week at different public places in Delhi.
 
• **Delhi**__
 
 
• Chief Minister: Arvind Kejriwal 
 
• Deputy CM: Manish Sisodia
 
• Lieutenant Governor of Delhi: Vinai Kumar Saxena
